sheets.name: up-uncovered
sheets.title: ULTRA PERFORMANCE ONLY: a strip a moving object has just uncovered
sheets.sub:
Not representative of the lossy DLL in other modes (there this release changes almost nothing). 4K output from 1280 x 720; the camera pans, objects move the other way.
Frame 38: the frame whose gap between this release and dll-2026-10-14 is closest to the mean gap. The 240 x 140 piece with the most just-uncovered pixels among those at most a tenth on the moving object, enlarged 3 times.
Under each picture: just-uncovered accuracy in this frame / over all 8 frames, dB against the true image (higher is better). dll-2026-10-14 did not skip frames in Ultra Performance.

speed.title: ULTRA PERFORMANCE ONLY: FSR 4 time per frame, ms (lower is better)
speed.sub: Not representative of other modes: at the Balanced preset's size this release's lossy DLL takes the same time as dll-2026-10-14.
speed.note: RX 7800 XT, Windows timing kit 2026-10-15 under Proton, moving picture, mean of 6 rounds; render size a third of the output.
series: lossy, dll-2026-10-14 (no frame skip in UP)
